consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance on July 22, 1972, at the Paramount Northwest Theatre was solid, particularly praising the first set. The sound quality is noted as very good for the era, contributing to an enjoyable listening experience despite some missing songs.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 16 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the sound quality and first set, the missing songs and some performance inconsistencies led to a more tempered overall enthusiasm.
